scope: First two-account, two-machine co-op connection: host lab instance (main account) coop_session host -> friends-only lobby; VM lab instance (second account) coop_session join <lobby> -> Steam P2P.

results.packets: host sent 76 / received 74; guest sent 74 / received 76

method: Host lab instance restarted alone (no local client), A + LoadGame 81 into the Dunwall fixture; VM instance already in the same fixture. VM movement via the Hyper-V keyboard (W 1.5 s); host movement via the simulated stick (1.5 s).
findings: Lab-mode coop_session host keeps the stale loopback connection handle (startOnlineHost only resets transport when an online session was already active), so with a local client the host rejects every lobby partner: confirmed static (session_online.h startOnlineHost/stopOnlineSession) and runtime (two rejected joins before this take).
Inside the VM the simulated controller packets are consumed but ignored by the game (0.00 m stick walk vs 6.27 m keyboard): the guest has no game-controller device; confirmed runtime.
At the title menu (state 6) LoadGame must follow an A press (Restore-D2Lab timing); an immediate LoadGame is ignored.
